description: This Java source file defines an abstract supervisor class for pub-sub actors in an Akka-based system, managing child actors with supervision strategies, restart scheduling, and actor name disambiguation.

classes.name: AbstractPubSubSupervisor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor supervisor for pub-sub components, handling child actor lifecycle, supervision strategy, and restart logic.

methods.name: createPubSubBehavior
methods.description: Abstract method to define pub-sub behavior for publishing or subscribing.

methods.name: onChildFailure
methods.description: Abstract callback invoked when a child actor fails.

methods.name: startChildren
methods.description: Abstract method to start child actors without regard for previous children.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Lifecycle hook to initialize child actors at startup.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Returns the list of seed integers used for hashing.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Defines the supervision strategy, restarting all children on any error with delay.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling, including pub-sub behavior and restart command.

methods.name: scheduleRestartChildren
methods.description: Schedules a restart of all child actors after a delay.

methods.name: startChild
methods.description: Starts a new child actor with a unique name based on a prefix.

methods.name: restartChildren
methods.description: Stops all current children and restarts them.
